notes.title: Level Competition [July 1 - July 11]
notes.content: [p]Don't like reading? Watch the promo video: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BDQVe95kuwY"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Welcome![/h3][p]Presenting our very first level competition! As you may or may not know, PreStrafe features a built-in level editor, every object can be placed, rotated, and scaled any which way you deem fit. This empowers players to design environments in creative ways that goes outside of the box. On top of the many movement mechanics, level creators can design the flow of their level that utilize or can even create new movement meta![/p][p][/p][h3]Getting Started[/h3][p]That's great and all... so, how do you enter?[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414720/PreStrafe/" style="button" buttoncolor="#50833a"]Request Access[/url][/p][p]Simply join the Steam Playtest for instant access, learn the basics of the movement, check out existing [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3414800/workshop/"]workshop levels[/url], and then get to creating your own level![/p][p][/p][h3]Info[/h3][list][*][p]Competition starts on [b]July 1st[/b] and ends on [b]July 11th[/b] at [b]12pm EST[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Level is judged based on Gameplay, Visuals, and Creativity for a total score[/p][/*][*][p]Levels must reach an average of 45 seconds time to finish (TTF) and a maximum of 5 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]Submit your level via [url="https://forms.gle/iy8az8eRDdrdEnDn6"]Google Form[/url] before the deadline[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Discord[/h3][p]Join the community via [url="https://dsc.gg/prestrafe"]Discord[/url] to learn the rules and to get assistance or tips on getting started.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Open Playtest - Wed April 9th
notes.content:
Prestrafers and... poststrafers, we're glad to announce that this Wednesday on the 9th, Steam Playtest registrations will be open to the public!

All signed up will receive an email of their invite and will automatically appear in your library. If you'd like to hang out, we have a [url=https://dsc.gg/prestrafe]Discord event[/url] at [b]6pm EST[/b], which would be a good time to talk with the dev and other players to learn any tips and tricks.

[url=https://dsc.gg/prestrafe][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351773/02c8b8e58e2c695253a2aed7ca8faf75a7978128.png[/img][/url]

[h3]What is there to do currently in PreStrafe?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Play the tutorial level (reading helps!)
[*] Practice and play on trial maps, earn a record on the leaderboards
[*] Post your runs on [url=https://www.speedrun.com/PreStrafe]speedrun.com[/url] (more official)
[*] Hang out on freeroam maps (Dev_Sandbox for max fun)
[*] Create your own level and publish to workshop
[*] Host your own server and invite your friends on your own level
[*] Learn with the community by joining the Discord
[/list]
